calls.reason: The problem inventory is unspecified; the NLU survey only urges caution about benchmark success and the Gato report shows partial transfer, so neither settles whether 'virtually none' were solved.
No AGI has been established: ARC Prize says Astra is not AGI and the AGI Society notes no accepted test, so the necessity of human-cognition insights cannot be checked.
RobustFill's pure induction model trailed Flash Fill but used four examples, and the matching synthesis model used symbolic execution; nothing covers one-example tests of May 2022 systems.
Gato's rudimentary dialogue points one way while PaLM beating average humans on a BIG-bench subset points the other; no evaluation calibrates 'remotely close' to the described competence.
Trillion-parameter Switch models and the 825 GiB Pile confirm scale, and a 2022 COGS study shows lasting structural failures, but the billions-in-spending and 1988 continuity remain unverified.
Flamingo's documented hallucinations and a paper qualifying GPT-3's semantic skills show limits, but nothing measures what careful observers concluded; 'nobody' is largely rhetorical.
